sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: Hail Ansharu with the plant task active to spawn the nine aged stonemites.
The ninth death brings Ancient Kayserops into the room.
Defeating Kayserops closes the expedition to additional members and updates the plant and sewer progression tasks.
